fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histopathological and/or cytopathological confirmation of locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC is in scope but does not provide a specific stage list for stage_in.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: At least one measurable lesion
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease is a subjective imaging assessment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: A minimum life expectancy of > 3 months
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Life expectancy is a subjective clinical judgment, not a typed lab or stage check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate bone marrow reserve, hepatic, renal, and coagulation function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General organ function without specific numeric lab cutoffs cannot be represented as typed lab checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant ever used the epidermal growth factor receptor-tyrosine kinase inhibitor (EGFR TKI) for anti-tumor therapy prior to enrollment (Cohort 1), or second generation EGFR TKI (Cohort 2)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior EGFR TKI restrictions differ by cohort, making it not a simple universal typed prior_therapy_excluded check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participant ever used the epidermal growth factor receptor-tyrosine kinase inhibitor (EGFR TKI) for anti-tumor therapy prior to enrollment (Cohort 1), or second generation EGFR TKI (Cohort 2)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy exclusions differ by cohort, making it complex for a single prior_therapy_excluded check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any systemic anti-tumor therapy such as chemotherapy and radiation therapy (including curative radiotherapy or spinal radiotherapy portion >30%) used within 3 weeks prior to enrollment; immunotherapy within 4 weeks; any palliative radiotherapy for non-target lesions used to relieve symptoms and traditional Chinese medicines indicated for the tumor within 2 weeks prior to enrollment; Cohort 2: any EGFR TKIs within 5 half-lives.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Multi-category washout windows with varying timeframes cannot be expressed using a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Confirmation that the tumor harbors an uncommon epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutation (tumor tissue biopsy)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: deterministic normalizer did not verify this model check
